verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so offline reading, searching and writing with sync on reconnect is a fair axis. Nothing in the pack documents offline mode, local caching on the client, or a queued-change sync on reconnect. The note about storing emails in a Durable Object and an R2 bucket describes server-side storage for speed, not client offline capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
